container_titles: Les Deux Concertos Pour Violon Et Orchestre
releases.recording_review: La Voix de Son Maître 2C 069-00194 is Menuhin and Erede in Paganini’s two violin concertos. This Warner file has both concertos, three movements each, with Menuhin, Erede and the Royal Philharmonic on every track.
limitations: The heading names the two concertos. It is not a third work.
The source calls Op. 6 D major. The digital title says E-flat major, the sounding key of that scordatura concerto.
The 1975 French LP mastering is not verified.
